title: Overfitting
summary: A model fits noise in the training data and generalizes poorly to new data.
recognition_signals: training performance keeps improving while validation performance stalls or worsens
the model is much more complex than the signal justifies
small changes in the training sample change the model a lot
core_rules: Model complexity and training signal must be balanced against validation performance.
structural_steps: fit the model on training data
stop or regularize before validation degrades

common_confusions.distinction: Leakage lets information the model should not have inflate the evaluation. Overfitting is a model that memorizes training signal and generalizes poorly on honest data.

source_refs.title: scikit-learn: Common pitfalls and recommended practices
